# Cirqco
# Kampala, Uganda technology company. Updated 2026-09-04.

> Cirqco is a technology company in Kampala, Uganda, founded by Maxwell Odoi (Odoi Dickson Maxwell).
> Mission: give Africa infrastructure the world has yet to imagine on its behalf — starting with startups, youth, everyday markets and the leadership willing to back them.
> It builds and ships four core products: My Village, Medveta, Sentinel and Cruizly.

Cirqco is not a property management company.
Cirqco is not a "coming soon" crypto landing page.
CirqcoX is one product (an investment platform), not the company homepage.
NexaCRM is a retired product line; it is no longer part of Cirqco's active portfolio.

## Products
- My Village — digital enterprise operating system for African business, finance and trust (pre-seed, US$250,000). https://cirqco.com/my-village
- Medveta — healthcare technology: Medveta HMS (hospital management — Patient Mobile, Doctor Mobile, HMS Desktop; live at https://medveta-hms.fastapicloud.dev/) and Medveta Distribution (pharmaceutical wholesale / B2B, in production). https://cirqco.com/medveta
- Sentinel — Security Intelligence System (SIS): edge-first physical intelligence for Security Command, cameras, Sentinel Edge, local recording, selected cloud evidence, Starlink connectivity, access control and farm herd monitoring. Commercial billing uses monitoring hours shared across cameras and Command sites, plus operator seats and cloud evidence; hardware and installation are assessed and quoted per property. Live at https://sentinel-0ead9947.fastapicloud.dev/ · https://cirqco.com/sentinel
- Cruizly — peer-to-peer vehicle rental with KYC, vehicle trust and a police portal (mobile, API, console). https://cirqco.com/cruizly

## Clients & partners
Cirqco has built for and consulted with: Aleph Hospitality (Dubai), Aziz Developments, Innovations Village Uganda, and Reach A Hand Uganda. https://cirqco.com/work#clients
